## Profile

I am an economist, statistician and Python developer working at the intersection of **economics, finance, mathematics and machine learning**. My experience spans regional economic analysis, financial-risk assessment, statistical modelling, time-series analysis and higher-education teaching.

I am particularly interested in using **econometrics, machine learning and deep learning** to study complex economic and financial systems. My approach combines economic reasoning, rigorous quantitative methods and clear communication, with an emphasis on models that are robust, interpretable and useful for decision-making.

## Areas of expertise

| Quantitative analysis | Economics and finance | Technology and communication |
|---|---|---|
| Statistical modelling | Business-cycle analysis | Python and R |
| Time-series analysis | Financial analysis | Data preparation and reporting |
| Machine learning | Corporate risk assessment | Reproducible workflows |
| Model evaluation | IAS/IFRS and French standards | Technical documentation |
| Econometrics | Financial strategy | Teaching and knowledge transfer |

## Professional experience

### Statistician and Economist | Banque de France
*2020-present*

- Lead the collection and quality assurance of regional economic data used for business-cycle analysis.
- Model and analyse statistical series to identify trends, structural breaks and decision-relevant signals.
- Produce monthly economic reports and communicate quantitative findings to non-specialist audiences.

### Adjunct Lecturer | INSEEC, ESSCA and ECE
*2019-present, alongside my main position*

- Teach financial analysis, mathematics and statistics from first-year undergraduate to Master's level.
- Supervise approximately ten final dissertations, covering research design, quantitative analysis and presentation.
- Translate technical concepts into practical frameworks for students from varied academic backgrounds.

### Senior Financial Analyst | Banque de France
*2011-2020*

- Assessed the financial risk of major French companies using statutory and consolidated accounts.
- Produced and presented structured, evidence-based analyses for professional decision-makers.
- Applied IAS/IFRS frameworks and French accounting standards to the interpretation of consolidated financial statements.

## Research and technical interests

My current interests include:

- financial econometrics and macro-financial forecasting;
- nonlinear dynamics and complexity in economic systems;
- machine learning and deep learning for time-series data;
- model interpretability, robustness and validation;
- the interaction between economic expertise and data-driven methods.

I am especially motivated by interdisciplinary projects that connect methodological depth with concrete economic or financial questions.

## Selected projects

I design and publish independent projects to deepen my technical practice and create reproducible, usable tools.

- **Personal website and technical portfolio:** development and publication of articles, analyses and technical projects on [ggilles.dev](https://ggilles.dev/).
- **Meal-booking web application:** functional design, project architecture and source-code publication.
- **Specification-driven development environment:** a dedicated workflow for developing software from explicit, testable specifications.

See my current work on [GitHub](https://github.com/guillaumegilles).

## What I bring

- More than a decade of experience connecting financial information with professional judgement.
- Hands-on responsibility for regional economic data, statistical analysis and recurring publications.
- A dual academic background in finance and business information systems.
- The ability to move from data preparation and modelling to interpretation, reporting and teaching.
- Professional fluency in French and English, with English at C1 level.
